concern_summary: This concern focuses on retrieving and calculating the appropriate tax rate based on transaction types and associated policies, ensuring correct tax application.
This concern relates to the creation and validation of tax rates based on user input, ensuring compliance with policy requirements.
This concern deals with retrieving and formatting default tax rates based on specific categories within policies to ensure accurate displays.
This concern centers around the retrieval and organization of applicable tax rates for transactions and reporting purposes, ensuring correct tax application based on current policies.
This concern handles the management of errors related to tax rates, clearing error fields and ensuring the integrity of tax rate actions.
